Now Innocence shall cease to be the spoile Of rauenous Greatnesse, or to steepe the soile Of raised Pesantrie with teares, and bloud; No more shall rich men (for their little good) Suspect to be made guiltie; or vile Spies Enioye the lust of their so murdring eyes: Men shall put off their Yron mindes, and hearts; The Time forget his olde malicious artes With this new minute; and no print remaine Of what was thought the former ages staine.
